A boat can be rowed 9 km. upstream or 18 km. downstream in a period of 3 hrs. What is the speed of the boat in still water in km/hr?
questions.expl: Upstream speed = 9/3 = 3 km/h; Downstream speed = 18/3 = 6 km/h. Still water speed = (3+6)/2 = 4.5 km/hr.

questions.q: Two pipes can separately fill a tank in 9 hours and 12 hours respectively. If both pipes are in operation, the tank will be filled in
questions.expl: Rate = 1/9 + 1/12 = 7/36 per hour; Time = 36/7 = 5 1/7 hours.

questions.q: Sum of three consecutive even integers is 54. Find the least among them.
questions.expl: Integers are x, x+2, x+4: 3x + 6 = 54 => 3x = 48 => x = 16.

questions.q: Two numbers are in the ratio 5 : 7 and their LCM is 315, their product is
questions.expl: Numbers 5k, 7k => LCM = 35k = 315 => k = 9. Numbers are 45 and 63. Product = 45 x 63 = 2835.

questions.q: 150 gm of sugar solution has 20% sugar in it. How much sugar should be added to make it 25% in the solution?
questions.expl: Initial sugar = 30g, water = 120g. If sugar becomes 25%, water is 75% => Total = 120 / 0.75 = 160g. Sugar added = 160 - 150 = 10g.

questions.q: A person travels from P to Q at a speed of 40 kmph and returns by increasing his speed by 50%. What is his average speed for both the trips?
questions.expl: Return speed = 40 + 50% = 60 kmph. Average speed = 2*40*60 / (40+60) = 4800 / 100 = 48 kmph.

questions.q: A can do 1/3 of a work in 5 days and B can do 2/5 of the work in 10 days. In how many days both A and B can do the work?
questions.expl: A takes 15 days; B takes 25 days. Combined rate = 1/15 + 1/25 = 8/75 per day => Time = 75/8 = 9 3/8 days.

questions.q: Find the smallest number which when divided by 57, 76 and 190, leaves the remainder 1 in each case.
2/3 rd of a number is 26. Find out 25% of that number.
The simple interest on Rs. 500 for 6 years at 5% per annum is

A alone can do a piece of work in 12 days. B, who is 60% more efficient than A, will finish the work in
questions.expl: Ratio of efficiency A:B = 100:160 = 5:8. Time taken by B = 12 x 5/8 = 15/2 = 7 1/2 days.

questions.q: Successive discount of 10% and 30% are equivalent to a single discount of ______.
Find the amount on Rs. 10,000 for 3 years at 10% compound interest, interest being payable annually.
The simplified value of (2.3 x 2.3 x 2.3 - 0.027) / (2.3 x 2.3 + 0.69 + 0.09) is
If 50% of P = 25% of Q, then P = x% of Q. Find x = ?
questions.expl: 0.5 P = 0.25 Q => P = 0.5 Q => P is 50% of Q. Hence x = 50.

questions.q: The ratio of two numbers is 10 : 7 and their difference is 105. The sum of the numbers is
A fruit seller bought 11 apples for Rs. 10 and sold 10 apples for Rs. 11. How much profit or loss did he make?
questions.expl: CP of 1 apple = 10/11; SP of 1 apple = 11/10. Profit% = ((121 - 100)/100)% = 21% profit.

questions.q: The ratio of the ages of A, B and C is 5 : 8 : 9. If the sum of the ages of A and C be 56 years, then the age of B is
questions.expl: 5x + 9x = 14x = 56 => x = 4. Age of B = 8 x 4 = 32 years.

questions.q: A certain number when divided by 175 leaves a remainder 132. When the same number is divided by 25, the remainder is
questions.expl: Number = 175q + 132. Since 175 is divisible by 25, 132 mod 25 = 7.

questions.q: 0.2 + 0.2 - 0.2 / 0.2 x (0.2 x 0.2), on simplification is
A sum of money becomes 27 times of itself in 3 years at compound interest. The rate of interest per annum is
If 579 * 2 be divisible by 11, the * mark digit is
questions.expl: Alternating sum: (5 + 9 + 2) - (7 + *) = 16 - (7 + *) = 9 - *. For divisibility by 11, * = 9.

questions.q: In a 200 m. race, A runs at 5 km/hr. A gives B a start of 8 m and still beats him by 8 seconds. Find the speed of B in metre per second.
A, B, C can do a piece of work in 6, 12 and 24 days respectively. They all together will complete the work in
A certain principal amounts to Rs. 560 in 3 years and Rs. 600 in 5 years. Determine the rate of interest per annum.
questions.expl: SI for 2 years = Rs. 40 => Rs. 20 per year. Principal = 560 - 3(20) = Rs. 500. Rate = (20 / 500) x 100 = 4%.

questions.question: Fill in the blank with an appropriate preposition from the list below: He was successful _______ completing the job within four days.
questions.explanation: 'Successful' takes the fixed preposition 'in' when followed by a gerund or noun phrase (successful in doing something).
questions.rule: Appropriate Preposition: successful in
questions.bengaliHint: 'successful'-এর পর 'in' বসে (কোনো কাজে সফল হওয়া বোঝাতে successful in completing the job)।

questions.question: Find the word which has the same meaning as 'Commence'.
questions.explanation: 'Commence' means to begin or start an event or operation.
questions.rule: Synonyms: Commence = Begin / Start
questions.bengaliHint: 'Commence' শব্দের অর্থ শুরু করা, যার সঠিক সমার্থক শব্দ হলো 'Begin'।

questions.question: Complete the idiom by choosing the right word from the options given below: When Deepak could not solve the problem he decided to give _______.
questions.explanation: The phrasal verb / idiom 'give up' means to stop trying, admit defeat, or surrender.
questions.rule: Phrasal Verb: give up (surrender / stop trying)
questions.bengaliHint: 'Give up' মানে হাল ছেড়ে দেওয়া বা চেষ্টা ত্যাগ করা।

questions.question: Replace the missing word with the right word from the options below: The man was so _______ that he believed that God Himself had drunk the milk offered.
questions.explanation: 'Credulous' means having too great a readiness to believe things; gullible. 'Credible' means believable; 'creditable' means praiseworthy; 'incredible' means unbelievable.
questions.rule: Confusing Words: credulous (gullible) vs credible (believable)
questions.bengaliHint: 'Credulous' মানে অতি-বিশ্বাসী বা নির্বোধের মতো যা বলা হয় তাই সহজে বিশ্বাস করে এমন ব্যক্তি।

questions.question: Choose the correct form of the verb from the options given below: He rushed to the hospital after he _______ the news.
questions.explanation: When two actions happened in the past, the earlier action is expressed in the Past Perfect tense ('had heard'), while the subsequent action uses Simple Past ('rushed').
questions.rule: Tense Rules: Past Perfect for earlier completed past action
questions.bengaliHint: অতীতের দুটি কাজের মধ্যে যেটি পূর্বে সম্পন্ন হয়েছিল তার ক্ষেত্রে Past Perfect (had heard) বসে।

questions.question: Choose from the following the correct indirect form of the sentence given: He said to me, 'I have never seen such a brilliant boy in my life'.
options: That I have never seen such a brilliant boy in my life, he said to me.
Such a brilliant boy was never seen in my life, he told me.
The boy was so brilliant that he had never seen the like of him.
He told me that he had never seen such a brilliant boy in his life.
questions.explanation: In indirect speech: 'said to' → 'told', comma replaced by 'that', pronoun 'I' → 'he', present perfect 'have never seen' backshifts to past perfect 'had never seen', and 'my life' → 'his life'.
questions.rule: Narration: Assertive sentence backshift with SON pronoun rule
questions.bengaliHint: 'said to' পরিবর্তিত হয়ে 'told' হয়, Conjunction 'that' বসে, এবং 'have seen' পরিবর্তিত হয়ে 'had seen' হয়।

questions.question: Change from Passive to Active Voice, choosing from the options below: The crazy girl was laughed at.
options: They laughed at the crazy girl.
At the crazy girl they laughed.
They were laughed at by the crazy girl.
The crazy girl laughed at them.
questions.explanation: In 'The crazy girl was laughed at', the agent was dropped. Converting to active requires supplying an indefinite subject 'They' in simple past tense: 'They laughed at the crazy girl.' The preposition 'at' must remain with the verb.
questions.rule: Voice Change: Passive to Active with supplied subject 'They'
questions.bengaliHint: Agent-হীন Passive-কে Active করতে 'They' কর্তা হিসেবে আনা হয় এবং preposition 'at' ক্রিয়াটির সাথেই থাকে।

questions.question: Find from below the word that means a plant that grows in hot-dry regions covered in spines but without leaves:
questions.explanation: A cactus is a succulent spiny plant without normal leaves adapted to thrive in arid desert environments.
questions.rule: One Word Substitution: Desert spiny plant = Cactus
questions.bengaliHint: মরু অঞ্চলের কাঁটাযুক্ত পাতাহীন উদ্ভিদকে 'Cactus' (ক্যাকটাস) বলে।

questions.question: Find out from the given words the opposite of 'Attack'.
questions.explanation: The antonym of 'Attack' (to assault or initiate violence) is 'Defend' (to protect or resist an attack).
questions.rule: Antonyms: Attack vs Defend
questions.bengaliHint: 'Attack' (আক্রমণ করা)-এর বিপরীত শব্দ হলো 'Defend' (আত্মরক্ষা বা প্রতিরোধ করা)।

questions.question: Find from below the word that means 'Enormous'.
questions.explanation: 'Enormous' means extremely large in size, quantity, or extent; its direct synonym is 'Huge'.
questions.rule: Synonyms: Enormous = Huge / Vast
questions.bengaliHint: 'Enormous' শব্দের অর্থ বিশালাকার বা প্রকাণ্ড, যার সঠিক প্রতিশব্দ 'Huge'।

questions.question: Choose from the list below the most appropriate word to fill in the blank: A _______ is a person who gets things secretly and illegally into or out of a country.
questions.explanation: A 'smuggler' is a person who moves goods illegally into or out of a country to evade taxes or prohibitions.
questions.rule: One Word Substitution: Illegal transporter across borders = Smuggler
questions.bengaliHint: সীমান্ত দিয়ে অবৈধভাবে ও গোপনে পণ্য আনা-নেওয়াকারী ব্যক্তিকে 'smuggler' (চোরাচালানকারী) বলে।

questions.question: Find out the appropriate word, that best fits the underlined part of the sentence: The handkerchief was turned into a bird by the magician.
questions.explanation: 'Turned into' means underwent a complete change in nature or form, perfectly matched by 'transformed'.
questions.rule: Contextual Vocabulary: turned into = transformed
questions.bengaliHint: 'Turned into' শব্দের অর্থ রূপ পরিবর্তিত হওয়া, যার সবচেয়ে উপযুক্ত বিকল্প হলো 'transformed'।

questions.question: He was too preoccupied _______ his studies to think of other matters.
questions.explanation: The adjective 'preoccupied' is followed by the fixed preposition 'with' ('preoccupied with his studies').
questions.rule: Appropriate Preposition: preoccupied with
questions.bengaliHint: 'Preoccupied'-এর পর সর্বদা fixed preposition 'with' বসে (পড়াশোনায় গভীরভাবে নিমগ্ন)।

questions.question: Change from Active to Passive Voice, choosing from the options below: The boys are flying kites in the sky.
options: Kites are flying in the sky by the boys.
In the sky, kites are flown by the boys.
Kites are being flown by the boys in the sky.
The flying of kites in the sky is done by the boys.
questions.explanation: Present Continuous active ('are flying') becomes 'is/am/are + being + V3' ('are being flown') in passive voice.
questions.rule: Voice Change: Present Continuous = are being + V3
questions.bengaliHint: Present Continuous Tense-এর Passive রূপ: Kites are being flown by the boys in the sky।

questions.question: Fill in the blank with an appropriate preposition listed below: The tired hawker sat _______ the tree.
questions.explanation: The preposition 'under' is used to denote position directly below or beneath the branches of a tree.
questions.rule: Prepositions of Place: sat under the tree
questions.bengaliHint: গাছের নিচে বা ছায়ায় বসতে 'under the tree' ব্যবহৃত হয়।

questions.question: Fill in the blank with an appropriate preposition from the list below: Sita and Meera quarrelled _______ themselves.
questions.explanation: The official answer key gives 'among' for reflexive pronoun 'themselves' in this sentence ('quarrelled among themselves').
questions.rule: Preposition: quarrelled among themselves
questions.bengaliHint: নিজেদের মধ্যে ঝগড়া করা বোঝাতে 'among themselves' ব্যবহৃত হয়।

questions.question: Replace the underlined verb with the most appropriate phrasal verb: He decided to visit him at his home.
questions.explanation: 'Call on' means to visit a person. 'Call for' means require/demand; 'call up' means telephone/summon; 'call off' means cancel.
questions.rule: Phrasal Verb: Call on = visit a person
questions.bengaliHint: কারও সাথে দেখা করতে যাওয়া (visit)-এর phrasal verb হলো 'Call on'।

questions.question: Fill in the blank with an appropriate preposition given below: Ram was good _______ Chemistry.
questions.explanation: 'Good at' is an appropriate prepositional idiom denoting competence or skill in an academic subject or sport.
questions.rule: Fixed Preposition: good at a subject
questions.bengaliHint: কোনো বিষয়ে বা বিদ্যায় পারদর্শী বোঝাতে 'good at' বসে।

questions.question: Change the following statement into an interrogative sentence: You have had your dinner.
options: What about your dinner, did you have it?
questions.explanation: In 'You have had your dinner', the first 'have' is the auxiliary verb. Inverting the auxiliary verb before the subject yields 'Have you had your dinner?'.
questions.rule: Sentence Transformation: Inverting auxiliary 'have' to form interrogative
questions.bengaliHint: Present Perfect বাক্যে auxiliary 'have'-কে Subject-এর আগে এনে প্রশ্ন তৈরি করা হয়: 'Have you had your dinner?'।

questions.question: Fill in the blank with an appropriate preposition from the list below: Rita's mother did not approve _______ her returning home so late at night.
questions.explanation: The verb 'approve' requires the fixed preposition 'of' ('approve of someone doing something').
questions.rule: Fixed Preposition: approve of
questions.bengaliHint: 'Approve'-এর পর সর্বদা fixed preposition 'of' বসে (অনুমোদন করা)।

questions.question: Fill in the blank with an appropriate word from the list below: Neither Lata nor Sujata _______ present in class on 14th October.
questions.explanation: When two singular subjects ('Lata', 'Sujata') are connected by 'neither... nor', the verb must agree in the singular ('was').
questions.rule: Subject-Verb Agreement: Neither... nor with singular subjects takes a singular verb
questions.bengaliHint: 'Neither... nor' দ্বারা দুটি একবচন Subject যুক্ত থাকলে ক্রিয়াপদটিও একবচন (was) হয়।

questions.question: Replace the missing word with the right word from the options below: All _______ Alok were present during the meeting.
questions.explanation: 'Except' means not including or excluding. 'Expect' means anticipate; 'accept' means agree to receive; 'exceed' means go beyond.
questions.rule: Confusing Words: except (excluding) vs accept (receive)
questions.bengaliHint: 'Except' মানে ব্যতিরেকে বা ছাড়া (অলোক ছাড়া বাকি সবাই উপস্থিত ছিল)।

questions.question: Choose the correct spelling from the options below:
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is 'Exaggerate' (double 'g', single 'r'), meaning to overstate beyond truth.
questions.rule: Spelling: E-X-A-G-G-E-R-A-T-E
questions.bengaliHint: সঠিক বানান হলো 'Exaggerate' (অতিরঞ্জিত করা)।

questions.question: Find from below the word that means 'Essential':
questions.explanation: 'Essential' means absolutely necessary or indispensable; its closest synonym is 'Vital'.
questions.rule: Synonyms: Essential = Vital / Indispensable
questions.bengaliHint: 'Essential' শব্দের অর্থ অপরিহার্য বা অত্যন্ত জরুরি, যার প্রতিশব্দ 'Vital'।

questions.question: Complete the idiom by choosing the right word from the options given below: The old lady was murdered in cold _______.
questions.explanation: The idiom 'in cold blood' means ruthlessly, intentionally, and without emotion or passion.
questions.rule: Idiom: in cold blood (without emotion or mercy)
questions.bengaliHint: 'In cold blood' একটি প্রচলিত বাগধারা, যার অর্থ ঠান্ডা মাথায় বা নির্মমভাবে হত্যা করা।

questions.question: Fill in the blank with an appropriate preposition from the list below: The policeman seized him _______ his arm and led him away.
questions.explanation: When catching, grabbing, or holding someone by a body part or clothing (arm, collar, hand), use the preposition 'by' ('seized him by his arm').
questions.rule: Preposition of Manner: seize/take someone by the arm
questions.bengaliHint: শরীরের কোনো অংশ বা পোশাক ধরে টানা বা পাকড়াও বোঝাতে 'by' বসে (seized him by his arm)।

questions.question: Choose the correct spelling from the options below:
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is 'Hyphenated' (from hyphen + ated, with single 'n' and single 'p').
questions.rule: Spelling: H-Y-P-H-E-N-A-T-E-D
questions.bengaliHint: সঠিক বানান হলো 'Hyphenated' (হাইফেনযুক্ত)।

questions.question: Complete the idiom by choosing the right word from the options given below: His old shoes have stood him in good _______ in his travels.
questions.explanation: The idiom 'stand someone in good stead' means to be of great advantage, usefulness, or service to someone over time.
questions.rule: Idiom: stand in good stead (prove useful over time)
questions.bengaliHint: 'Stand in good stead' একটি বিখ্যাত প্রবাদপ্রতিম Idiom, যার অর্থ প্রয়োজনের সময় বিশেষ উপকারে আসা।

questions.question: Choose the most appropriate word to fill in the blank: The examiner could not understand the candidate's handwriting because it was _______.
questions.explanation: 'Illegible' refers to handwriting that is not clear enough to be read.
questions.rule: One Word Substitution: Handwriting that cannot be read = Illegible
questions.bengaliHint: যে হাতের লেখা পড়া যায় না বা অস্পষ্ট তাকে 'illegible' (অপাঠ্য) বলা হয়।

questions.question: Replace the underlined word with the right alternative from the options given: The time allowed for the work should have been adequate.
questions.explanation: 'Adequate' means satisfactory or acceptable in quality or quantity; its exact synonym is 'sufficient'.
questions.rule: Synonyms: Adequate = Sufficient / Enough
questions.bengaliHint: 'Adequate' শব্দের অর্থ পর্যাপ্ত বা যথেষ্ট, যার সঠিক বিকল্প হলো 'sufficient'।
